@@U04128@@
Our young and tested troops will check their progress.

@@U04130@@
Then admit this vigorous hero into your ranks, for once he’s with you you'll see what he’s capable of.

@@U04131@@
(He points to the one on his right.)

@@U04133@@
(Stepping forward.)

@@U04134@@
Who looks me in the face, he runs the hazard Of being well scored over cheek and mazard; Who turns his back to me—well, he may risk it, But down he'll topple, cleft from chin to brisket. And if your men will only then With sword and mace strike home like me, Your foes amain will strew the plain, Bathed in their blood as in a sea.

@@U04135@@
(Exit.)

@@U04137@@
Center phalanx advance at full strength, but with caution. Over there to the right I see we've made good headway, upsetting the enemy’s plans.

@@U04139@@
(Pointing to the one in the middle.)

@@U04140@@
This one, too, must join your command. He'll sweep all before him.

@@U04142@@
(Stepping forward.)

@@U04143@@
Add to the army’s blood and thunder The all-essential lust to plunder; Let every man make his intent To pillage the rival emperor's tent! He hasn't long to flaunt his pride, As long as I the phalanx guide.
translation:
@@U04128@@
我们年轻且经过考验的部队将检查他们的进展。

@@U04130@@
然后让这位充满活力的英雄加入你的队伍，因为一旦他和你在一起，你就会看到他的能力。

@@U04131@@
（他指着他右边的那个。）

@@U04133@@
（向前迈出一步。）

@@U04134@@
谁看着我的脸，他就有可能在脸颊和马扎德上留下深刻的印象；谁背对着我——好吧，他可能会冒险，但他会倒下，从下巴到胸口裂开。如果你的手下像我一样用剑和狼牙棒击中目标，你的敌人将遍布平原，沐浴在他们的鲜血中，就像沐浴在大海中一样。

@@U04135@@
（退出。）

@@U04137@@
中央方阵全力推进，但要小心谨慎。在右边，我看到我们已经取得了很好的进展，打乱了敌人的计划。

@@U04139@@
（指着中间的那个。）

@@U04140@@
这个也必须加入你的指挥。他将横扫面前的一切。

@@U04142@@
（向前迈出一步。）

@@U04143@@
给军队的血与雷增添了掠夺的万能欲望；让每个人都意图掠夺敌对皇帝的帐篷！他没多久就可以炫耀自己的骄傲了，只要我方阵引导。
